profile.name: ASI Tiger多轴运动控制器
profile.description: 用于显微成像与自动化实验的多轴硬件控制器。它通过串口控制电动载物台/位移轴，并可协调扫描、滤光轮、二向色镜滑块、逻辑触发、波形输出以及相机、激光和远焦等时序信号。
profile.description_en: A multi-axis hardware controller for microscopy and automated experiments. It communicates over serial to control motorized stages/axes and can coordinate scanning, filter wheels, dichroic sliders, logic triggering, waveform output, and timing signals for cameras, lasers, and remote focus devices.
